note: The glade's people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (Mayfly Glade): Elder Thimbleroot inside the stockade gives the first two, Hedgewarden Tansy a few steps north of him the three hunts; Weaver Mossbutton, at the north side of the stockade, is the outfitter; Coachman Twigg keeps the stable on the grass outside the east gate (his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes); the mayfly swarms (the hollow south of the stockade), the glade snakes (the woods to the west) and the badger Old Greyback (alone, far to the north-west) are placed for these quests.

L1.name: A Sprout's Acorn Sash
offer: Well, well! A new sprout, and not a crumb on you yet. We shall mend that. But first things first: no brownie of the glade goes about without an acorn sash.
Weaver Mossbutton stitches them, up at the north side of the stockade. Tell her I sent you, or she will talk your ears off first.
Will you fetch your sash and show it to me?
L1.declined: No hurry, sprout. The acorns are not going anywhere.
L1.started: Off you trot. North side, by the big leaves. Follow the humming.

piece.name: acorn-cap sash
piece.description: A sash of plaited grass sewn with acorn caps. Every brownie of Mayfly Glade wears one, and keeps a crumb or two tucked in it.

fetch.journal: Ask Weaver Mossbutton, at the north side of the stockade, for an acorn-cap sash.
fetch.says: A new sprout! Arms up. Plaited grass, seven acorn caps, one for luck. There. Not a button to pay, dear. Mind you keep it tidy.

show.journal: Show the acorn-cap sash to Elder Thimbleroot.
show.says: Now you look a proper brownie. Keep a crumb tucked in it. You never know when you will want one.

L2.name: Bound to the Glade
offer: The wide world is full of large feet, sprout. Have Spiritmaster Fennick bind your spirit to the glade, so that you wake here if one of them lands on you.
Then give your name to Coachman Twigg for his ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
L2.declined: Then look up often, sprout. Very often.
L2.started: Fennick is by the west fence. Twigg waits on the grass outside the east gate.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Fennick, by the west fence of the stockade, bind your spirit to the glade.
bind.says: There now. Whatever lands on you, you will wake here among friends, and likely in time for supper. Off to Coachman Twigg with you.

ledger.journal: Give your name to Coachman Twigg, outside the east gate, for his ledger.
ledger.says: Name in the book, sprout! My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Splendid. Now you can always come home, one way or the other.
Twigg's coach will carry you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the road to Rivervale is earned. Hedgewarden Tansy, just north of me, has work for you.

L3.name: Mayflies in the Honey
offer: So you are the new sprout. Good, I need quick hands. The mayflies are swarming in the hollow south of the stockade, and they are into the honey pots again.
Swat a few swarms and bring me three wings. Then I will show you a trick worth having.
L3.declined: Then it is dry bread for supper, and you may tell Pippkin why.
L3.started: Three wings. Out the east gate and round to the south, down in the hollow.

drop.name: mayfly wing
drop.description: A glassy wing from a mayfly swarm of the hollow south of the stockade.

hunt.journal: Take three mayfly wings from the mayfly swarms in the hollow south of the stockade.

give.journal: Bring three mayfly wings to Hedgewarden Tansy.
give.says: Three wings, and no honey on your fingers. I am almost surprised. Now watch closely, sprout, and learn this.

L4.name: A Sprout's Arms
offer: A brownie's wits are sharp, but a wolf does not mind wits. I will make you proper gear, if you fetch what I need.
Weaver Mossbutton has a leather strip and a shaft put by for me. Then take a fang from the glade snakes in the woods west of the stockade.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then stay inside the fence, where your wits are enough.
L4.started: Leather and a shaft from Mossbutton, a fang from the snakes. Hop to it.

materials.journal: Ask Weaver Mossbutton for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Tansy? Here you are, dear: a strip of leather and a nice straight shaft. Tell her she still has my good needle.

drop.name: glade snake fang
drop.description: The thin fang of a glade snake from the woods west of the stockade.

hunt.journal: Take a glade snake fang from the glade snakes in the woods west of the stockade.

give.journal: Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the glade snake fang to Hedgewarden Tansy.
give.says: All three! A moment... the fang for a point, the leather for a grip. There. It is yours, sprout. Do not poke the grocer with it.

L5.name: Old Greyback
offer: One thing more before Rivervale has you. An old badger we call Greyback has dug in among the trees far to the north-west. He has dug up two of our gardens and chased the gardeners up a pine.
He is bigger than three of us and cross as a wet cat, so strike first. Bring me his claw, and I will teach you the last trick I have for a sprout.
Will you see to Old Greyback?
L5.declined: He will not grow any sweeter while you wait.
L5.started: North-west, a good long walk through the trees. Mind his claws.

drop.name: Greyback's claw
drop.description: A blunt grey claw, as long as a brownie's arm, from the badger Old Greyback.

hunt.journal: Take Greyback's claw from the badger Old Greyback in the woods far north-west of the stockade.

give.journal: Bring Greyback's claw to Hedgewarden Tansy.
says: Greyback's own claw! The gardeners can come down from their pine. You are a sprout no longer.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Burrowby at the east gate when you are ready for Rivervale.

flight.name: The Road to Rivervale
offer: The halflings of Rivervale keep good tables and open doors, and they have always been kind to our kind. Tansy says you are ready for them.
You have earned the road, sprout. I will set you down among your own guild in Rivervale, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to Rivervale?
flight.declined: Rivervale will keep. Halflings are patient about guests.
flight.started: Mind your manners, and save me a pie!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Burrowby when you are ready to go to Rivervale.
